description: This file implements a chunk-based API for handling data buffers and file I/O, including memory mapping, file pread, and temp file management, within the lighttpd web server project.

classes.name: chunk
classes.description: Represents a data chunk, either in memory or a file, with associated metadata and methods for management.

classes.name: chunk_file_view
classes.description: Represents a memory-mapped view of a file segment for efficient file access.

classes.name: chunkqueue
classes.description: A queue of chunks used for managing data streams in the server.

methods.name: chunkqueue_set_chunk_size
methods.description: Sets the default size for memory chunks in the queue.

methods.name: chunk_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new chunk.

methods.name: chunk_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a chunk of a specified size, either from pool or new.

methods.name: chunk_release
methods.description: Releases a chunk back to the pool.

methods.name: chunkqueue_append_mem
methods.description: Appends a memory buffer as a chunk to the queue.

methods.name: chunkqueue_append_file
methods.description: Appends a file chunk to the queue.

methods.name: chunkqueue_mark_written
methods.description: Marks a specified amount of data as written, updating the queue state.
